messages:
Maria (sec-eng): Heads-up — planning a focused entitlement deep-dive this weekend. goal: remove stale admin bindings, validate KMS grants, and run a quick audit-log replay. who can help own the playbook?
Ash (infra): I can take the KMS binding sweep. want to run a sampled dry-run first.
Jon (platform): I can wire up the report generation and the canary rollback hooks. do we want to use the repo script or the ad-hoc query?
Maria (sec-eng): Use the repo script so it's repeatable. Jon — add a `--dry-run` flag if not already there.
Sami (oncall): FYI oncall: if we trigger any automated alerts during the audit-log replay, please tag paging rules to suppress noisy paging and create an incident only for real auth failures.
Ash (infra): noted. I'll scope KMS: list bindings older than 90 days and owners with no activity in 45 days. will post CSV.
Jon (platform): here's the command I'll run in dry-run:
```
./scripts/generate_entitlement_report --scope=admin --age=90 --format=csv --dry-run
```
I'll push artifacts to `s3://redwood-sec/entitlement-runs/5111111111/`.
Maria (sec-eng): good. add a second column for `last_seen_token_use` so we can triage service accounts vs humans.
Sami (oncall): small ask: if we revoke anything during this window, ensure there's an immediate rollback path with a short TTL grant. no permanent deletes.
Jon (platform): agreed — will include a rollback playbook snippet and a one-click grant script.
entitlement-bot: Automated reminder: entitlement deep-dive scheduled Sat 07:00 UTC. Report template created at /playbooks/entitlement/deep_dive.md :bell:
Maria (sec-eng): Thanks — can everyone ACK here if available Saturday morning?
Ash (infra): ack :thumbsup:
Jon (platform): ack
Sami (oncall): ack — I'll monitor alerts and hold rollback creds.
Maria (sec-eng): perfect. quick followup: after the sweep, we'll run a lightweight regression eval on staging routes that depend on admin roles (deploy gates) — Jon, can you add smoke checks?
Jon (platform): yep — smoke checks: login-as-service, deploy-check, kms-access-test. I'll attach results to the run artifacts.
Maria (sec-eng): great. last note: capture audit-log replay command and include a snippet to redact PII before we hand artifacts to compliance.
Ash (infra): will do. uploading sample CSV shortly.
Maria (sec-eng): thanks team — see you Sat. if anything changes ping `#eng-security` and tag me.
